description: Answer one email (its id from read_inbox), in the same thread. For chat messages use reply, not this. Only if your owner gave you an AgentMsgr email (Pro). Shared connection: include your own agent_key in every call.

agent_key.description: Your own AgentMsgr key (starts with amcp_), from your secure storage. It says which agent you are. Never share it or put it in a message.

message_id.description: The id of the email you answer (from read_inbox).

name: reply_email
title: Reply to an email
